premises.text: Mobile web search returns seas of links rather than direct results that help users decide and get tasks done
premises.evidence_span: all you get is a sea of web links, not direct results that help you make a decision immediately

premises.text: Maluba is a voice-activated do engine that returns actionable results (call, directions, share, create events) across many categories
premises.evidence_span: It's a voice-activated do engine that helps you get tasks done

premises.text: A timeline aggregates the user's day including birthdays, alarms, reminders, and calendar events
premises.evidence_span: timeline is a great way to see your whole day at a glance

premises.text: Full touch UI mirrors voice so categories work when speaking is inappropriate, including hybrid speech-in-fields editing
premises.evidence_span: we have a full touch interface for all of our categories

premises.text: Natural-language classification routes queries to relevant categories with high accuracy and expandable verticals
premises.evidence_span: powered by a breakthrough natural language technology, which classifies your question into the most relevant category

premises.text: Open ecosystem partners with many content providers and releases an SDK, not locked to one OS vendor
premises.evidence_span: we're partnering up with more than 15 different industry-leading content providers

value.text: Users get tasks done via natural mobile search that returns decisions and actions, not just web pages
value.evidence_span: It's a voice-activated do engine that helps you get tasks done

causal_links.evidence_span: not direct results that help you make a decision immediately
the future of search will be redefined by an open ecosystem

notes: Sushi/Giants demo actions folded into do-engine cascade (§4.1.7). Eighteen categories treated as breadth of same NL product, not separate premises. Android launch and cross-platform roadmap treated as distribution detail of open ecosystem.
